title: Git stored credentials
whyItMatters: The Git store credential helper keeps plaintext logins for remote repositories. Anyone with the disk could reuse them.
notes: Only applies when the store helper is in use. The macOS Keychain helper stores credentials elsewhere and is not covered here.

cleanup.exportFirst: Move any token you still need into a password manager first; this file holds them as plain text.
cleanup.signOut: Revoke those tokens at each Git host, for example GitHub Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens.
steps: Open the file named in the plan and note which hosts have saved logins.
Revoke each of those tokens on the host website.
Delete the file named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Git asks for credentials again on the next push or pull; a token you forget to revoke still works.
